title: Transgender People
summary: Misinformation about transgender people often spreads false claims about medical care, regret rates, children's identities, and biological sex.
introduction: Transgender people face widespread misinformation campaigns that misrepresent medical consensus, distort research findings, and promote harmful stereotypes. These myths are frequently used to justify discriminatory legislation and denial of healthcare access. The reality, supported by major medical organizations worldwide including the American Medical Association, British Medical Association, Royal Australian College of Physicians, and World Professional Association for Transgender Health, is that transgender identities are valid, gender-affirming care is evidence-based and necessary, and transgender people deserve equal rights and dignity.
